tbesh_html:
§ Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece"
1) Greece, Ionia, Ionians
2) location of descendants of Javan

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia
strongs_1890.derivation: probably from the same as H3196 (יַיִן); effervescing (i.e. hot and active);
